# BankSize <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

```blitzbasic
BankSize:Int32 bank:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bank` | In | Int32 | required | The bank handle. |

**Returns:** The size of a bank in bytes.

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Examples

```blitzbasic
bank = CreateBank(16)
Print BankSize(bank)
FreeBank bank
```
